verbetes.glosa_atual: (גּזַם) uma figura de linguagem, uma hipérbole.
notas_originais: B. Mets. 104 b ג' בעלמא הוא דקגזים he used only a hyperbolical expression (‘a thousand Zuz’). Arakh. 11 a וסימנך מתניתא ג' and thy mnemotechnical sign (to remember who said a hundred and who a thousand) be: the Boraitha (or Mishnah) frequently uses hyperboles. Bets. 4 a; a. fr.—V. הֲבַאי.

Y. Sab. XIX, beg., 16 d; Bab. ib. 130 b ר' יהודה הג' R. J. the surgeon. [Cmp. גְּזוֹרִי.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: multidão, pessoas, nação; por favor. גּוֹיִם gentios, fr. qual גּוֹי = נָכְרִי ou עכו"ם, gentio, idólatra.
definicoes_originais: crowd, people, nation; pl. גּוֹיִם gentiles, fr. which גּוֹי = נָכְרִי or עכו"ם, gentile, idolator.
notas_originais: Tosef. Ab. Zar. III, 4 sq.; Y. ib. IV, 41 a top contrad. to כותי (Bab. ib. 29 a נכרי); a. v. fr.— Pl. גּוֹיִים, גּוֹיִם. Ab. Zar. I, 1 sq. in Y. ed. ג' (Bab. ed. נכרים, עכו"ם, Mish. עכומ"ז, נכרים indiscriminately); a. v. fr.—Fem. גּוֹיָה gentile woman. Y. Yeb. II, 4 a top ואין בנך מן הג' וכ' thy son from a gentile is not called thy son but her son (Bab. ib. 23 a נכרית); a. fr.— Pl. גּוֹיוֹת. Y. ib. IV, 6 a bot. [Y. Gitt. I, 43 b top, a. e. גויים לוקין, v. גַּיּוּס.]

Y. Ber. IV, 8 b top לכל ג' וג' וכ' to each creature its needs. Mikv. X, 7 לפסול את הג' to make the inner body unfit (for receiving T’rumah); Toh. I, 3 הגְּוִויָּה; a. fr.— Pl. גְּוִיּוֹת, גְּוִיּיוֹת. Yoma 80 b טומאת ג' some ed. (oth. sing.) the uncleanness of the inner body.
Nidd. 25 a; Y. ib. III, 50 d. Kidd. 25 a; a. fr.— Pl. גְּוִיּוֹת. Midr. Sam. ch. XX גויית some ed. (corr. acc.).
Targ. Y. Gen. VII, 23; a. fr.— Pl. גְּוִיָּיתָא. Targ. Is. VI, 2 גויותהון Kimḥi in ed. Ven. I, read גְּוִיָיתְהוֹן (ed. תֵיה …, corr. acc.). Targ. Ezek. I, 11.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גוּל); uma pedra rolante, pedra bruta não aparada, calçada.; um rolo de pergaminho.
definicoes_originais: a rolling stone, rough untrimmed stone, cobble.
notas_originais: B. Bath. I, 1; expl. ib. 3 a ג' אבני דלא וכ' untrimmed stones. B. Mets. 117 b

Y. M. Kat. III, 83 b bot. must rend his garments הג' בפני עצמו וכ' once for the burnt parchment and a second times for the writing; Bab. ib. 26 a אחת על הג' Ms. M.—Ib. (ref. to Jer. XXXVI, 27) המגילה זה הג' Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) m’gillah refers to the writing paper, hadd’barim to the writing.— Pl. גְּוִילִין. Ab. Zar. 18 a I see ג' נשרפין וכ' En Yakob (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50, ed. incorr. גליון) the parchment burned but the letters soar upward.—Esp. g’vil, a certain kind of parchment, v. דּוּכְסוּסְטוֹס. Tosef. B. Bath. IV, 7 (if one sold) ספר של צבאים … של ג' a book for deer-skin and it is found to be g’vil. Mass. Sof’rim I, 4. Sabb. 79 b; a. e.
Targ. Y. Deut. XXXI, 24 (h. text ספר). [Y. Meg. IV, 75 b bot., v. גּוּל.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: para formar uma bola, circule; para enrolar um pergaminho da Lei.
definicoes_originais: to form a ball, circle; to roll up a scroll of the Law.
notas_originais: Y. Yoma VII, 44 b top שאין גָּלִין וכ'; Y. Meg. IV, 75 b bot. שאין גולים (read גָּלִים or גּוֹלְלִ', v. גָּלַל) the Book of the Law must not be rolled up (to prepare the place to be read from) in the presence of the congregation. Denom. גְּוִיל, גִּיל. [In b. h. גּוּל or גִּיל to dance, rejoice.]
Part. גָיֵיל (גָּוֵיל). Y. Yoma VII, 44 b top [read:] תהא גייל לה לאחורי פרוכתא thou must roll it (the scroll, v. preced.) behind the curtain; Y. Meg. IV, 75 b bot. (corr. acc.).
, v. גַּלְגֵּל Ithpalp.
גְּוַל (גול) ball, roll. Targ. Is. XXXVIII, 12 some ed. כג' גרדאין like the weavers’ roll (v., however, נַוְולָא web ; oth. ed. מנחל גידודין, כנחל גדודאין).

definicoes_originais: w. Y. Snh. VII, end, 25 d נסב חדא ג' וכ' took a skull and threw it upward.
notas_originais: — Pl. גּוּלְגְּלַיָּא capitation taxes. Lev. R. s. 33 (Yalk. Dan. 1061 גֻּלְגֹּלִיּוֹת).

Ab. II, 6. Snh. 65 b הנשאל בג' he who consults a skull (as a conjurer). Koh. R. to XII, 6 ‘the golden bowl’ (גולת ib.) is the head (bowed down in old age); a. e.— Pl. גּוּלְגֹלִיּוֹת. Num. R. s. 19; Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 20 ג' וזרועות וכ' innumerable skulls, arms &c.
Y. Keth. X, end, 34 a; ib. XIII, 35 d, v. אַרְנוֹנָא. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 1; a. fr.— Pl. as above. Y. Peah I, 15 b bot.—Yalk. Dan. 1061, v. preced.; a. fr.
Targ. Ex. XVI, 16; a. fr. Targ. II Esth. III, 9 גּוּלְגְּלָתָא.—Tam. 32 b והבו ליה ג' חדא they gave him (Alexander the Great) a skull. Ib. ג' דעינא, v. גַּלְגְּלָא.
B. Bath. 8 a; Ned. 62 b כסף ג', v. בְּלוֹ. Pesik. Shek. p. 11 a גּוּלְגַּלְתֵּיךְ thy capitation tax (for the Roman government); a. e.

definicoes_originais: exile, esp. (with or without בני) the diaspora, Jews living abroad, esp. Babylonians.

Snh. 38 a; Ḥull. 92 a ר' ג' שבבבל; a. e.—עולי ג' those returning from Babylonian captivity. B. Bath. 15 a bot.—V. גָּלוּת.
Lev. R. s. 32, a. e. (used for play on גּולֶה, a. גּוֹאֲלָהּ), v. גּוֹאֵל.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גלל, cmp. גַּל) a pedra colocada no topo de uma caverna funerária, pedra superior, contrad. para דּוֹפֵק.
definicoes_originais: (גלל, cmp. גַּל) the stone placed on top of a burial cave, top-stone, contrad. to דּוֹפֵק.
notas_originais: Ohol. II, 4; a. fr.—סתימת הַגּ' the closing of the tomb with the golel. Snh. 47 b; Sabb. 152 b עד שיסתם הג'.—Erub. 15 b; Succ. 23 a cannot be used ג' לקבר for closing up a grave, i.e. if put on top, it is not considered a golel in levitical law, v. Ḥull. 72 a
Targ. Job. XIV, 22; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: uma massa enrolada e disforme, de onde; caroço, uma substância sem forma ou sem vida.; assunto inacabado, um navio querendo terminar, opp. פשוט superfície plana, sem formar receptáculo.; corpo.
definicoes_originais: a rolled up, shapeless mass, whence
lump, a shapeless or lifeless substance.
unfinished matter, a vessel wanting finishing, opp. פשוט plain surface, forming no receptacle.
notas_originais: Y. Nidd. III, 50 d and the other limbs of the embryo look כמין ג' מצומתים like a lump, squeezed together. Gen. R. s. 14 העמידו ג' He made him stand, a large, lifeless mass. Ib. s. 24 ג' בראו וכ' He formed him into a huge body, which extended from one end &c. Ib. (ref. to Ps. CXXXIX, 16) ג' שראו עיניך (read גֹּולָמִים) the embryos which Thy eyes have seen, have all been recorded (preordained) &c.; Pesik. R. s. 23; a. fr.—Ib. s. 33 גלומי היו (read גְּלוּמִין or גולמין) they were (hard) lumps (blocks).

Snh. 22 b אשה ג' היא ואינה וכ' woman (unmarried) is an unfinished vessel, and she makes a covenant with (cares for) none but him who made her a vessel.— Pl. גֹּולָמִים, גֳּלָ', constr. גֹּולְמֵי. Kel. XII, 6 ג' כלי מתכות unfinished metal vessels, v. defin. Ḥull. 25 a; Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 10.—Ib. VII, 12 גֹלָמִין (ed. Zuck. גלמי) pumpkins in their natural shape, opp. to חתוכין ומנוקבין.—Sifré Num. 158 כלים ולא גלומים (Yalk. ib. 786 גֹּולְמִין) ‘vessels’ which means finished vessels but not half-finished.—Trnsf. uneducated, unrefined. Ab. V, 7.
Pl. as above. Sifré Num. 131; Yalk. ib. 771 the spear entered בשני ג' both bodies.

IX, 5 קטילת ג' (for b. h. הֶרֶג) death by stoning.—Snh. 95 a [read:] אייתו לי … גולמא (דטינא) ונירגמינה bring ye unto me, each of you a stone (lump of clay), and we shall stone it (overthrow the city with mere stones); cmp. Yalk. Is. 284; Ar. s. v. גולמהרג.
, Snh. 95 a, v. preced.

Yoma 12 a it is usage to leave in the inn ג' ומשכא the (empty) wine pitcher and the hide (of the slaughtered animal). Ned. 49 b שקיל ג' וכ' would carry a pitcher (on which to sit during the lectures) on his shoulder.— Pl. גּוּלְפַיָּא, גּוּלְפֵי. B. Bath. 71 a the house דמחזיק מאה ג' which has room for one hundred jugs (placed in rows). Ab. Zar. 32 a בג' חיורי in unglazed jugs. Ḥag. 25 b למיטרח אג' to provide jugs (for the harvest). [גולפין, Targ. Esth. IX, 5, a clerical tautography of גולמין, v. גֹּולְמָא.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גול, גלל; cmp. גְּלִימָא) [ invólucro,] um longo manto de lã usado nas orações.
definicoes_originais: (גול, גלל; cmp. גְּלִימָא) [ wrapper,] a long woolen cloak of state used at prayers.
notas_originais: Sabb. 77 b (playful etymology) ג' גלי ותיב Ar. a. Rashi, roll it up and sit down (Ms. O. גלי ואייתי travel abroad and import it, ed. גלי ואתיב uncover thyself and put it down). Y. Kil. IX, end, 32 d to wrap up money גו גֹולְתֵה וכ' in one’s cloak and tie it up with linen cords. Y. Taan. III, 66 d top עצור גֹּולְתָךְ וכ' save thy cloak from the rain (a sneer at an unefficacious prayer for rain). Ib. IV, 67 c את יהב לִי גֹולְתִי וכ' give me my cloak that we may pray at the time of closing the gates (sunset). B. Mets. 85 a ג' דדהבא וכ' they spread over thee a gold-trimmed cloak (at graduation ceremonies); a. fr.— Pl. גֹּולָתָא, גֹּולְיָתָא, גֹּולְיָין. Targ. Y. II Num. XV, 38 גֹולַתְהֹון, I גּוּלְיַתְהֹון a. גּוּלֵיהֹון. Targ. Y. ib. XVI, 1 גֹּולְיָיתֵיה his cloaks. Ib. 2 גֹּולְיַין. Targ. Y. I Deut. XXII, 12 גֹּולְיַית־, II גֹּולָתֵי־. Ib. XXXIII, 19.—Gen. R. s. 36 (expl. סרבלי־ Dan. III, 2

verbetes.glosa_atual: (=גּוּדָּא); parede.; gunda, nome de um macacão doméstico usado no trabalho para proteção das roupas, espanador.
definicoes_originais: gunda, name of a domestic overall used at work for the protection of one’s clothes, duster.
notas_originais: Pl. גּוּנְדֵּי. Sot. 22 b דחייפי ג' (Ar. s. v. חף 5, v. infra) who scratch themselves against the walls (in saintly self-chastisement).

*Gitt. 68 b (in Hebr. diction) גּוּנְדּוֹ his duster (was all that was left to Solomon) (Snh. 20 b (Ms. M.) Yalk. Kings 177, Tanḥ. Aḥăre 1 קודו; Koh. R. to II, 10 קודיה; Y. Snh. II, 20 c bot. קניא). Sabb. 119 a R. Anan (while preparing for the Sabbath) לביש ג' (Ms. O. גורנא, Alf. Ms. גודנא, Asheri ed. Ven. גונרא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2) put a gunda on.— Pl. גּוּנְדֵּי. Sot. 22 b בי דינא … מהני דחפו ג' let the great Court call to account those who are wrapt up in overalls (hypocrites whom you cannot see through; Rashi: those who wrap themselves in cloaks as though they were true Pharisees; oth. vers., v. supra).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גדל II; נ inserido, cmp. próximo ws.) forma espiral, (sub. כתב) escrita em forma espiral (cmp. bustrophedon grego), esp. assinaturas das testemunhas alternadamente em caligrafia hebraica (da direita para a esquerda) e em grego (da esquerda para a direita).
definicoes_originais: (גדל II; נ inserted, cmp. next ws.) spiral form, (sub. כתב) writing in spiral form (cmp. Greek bustrophedon), esp. signatures of witnesses alternately in Hebrew handwriting (from the right to the left) and in Greek (from the left to the right).
notas_originais: Gitt. 87 b (ref. to two documents side by side on the same sheet with two Hebrew and two Greek signatures going through from under one document to the other), דילמא ג' חתים וכולהו וכ' perhaps it was signed gund’lith, and all the signatures belong to one document (to the one on the right in the case of Hebrew commencing the spire, to that on the left, if Greek begins the spire). Ib. (ref. to a case when Hebrew and Greek signatures alternate with each other) דילמא ג'חתים ותלתא וכ' perhaps it was signed gund’lith, so that three of the signatures belong to one document, and only one to the other. [For oth. interpret. v. comment. a. Ar. Compl. s. v. גנדל.]
, v. גְּרוּנְדֵּי
